name: Arshad Khan (Indian cricketer)
profileSummary: Arshad Khan is an Indian cricketer who plays for Madhya Pradesh in domestic cricket and currently for Gujarat Titans in the Indian Premier League. He made his List A debut on 24 February 2021, for Madhya Pradesh in the 2020–21 Vijay Hazare Trophy. He made his T20 debut for Mumbai Indians in 2023 Indian Premier League, against Royal Challengers Bangalore on 2 April 2023.
